latest.title: Orchestrating Agents on Amazon Bedrock
latest.description: Most multi-agent designs assume they can push. A coordinator has something for a participant, so it sends a notification and the session wakes up. That assumption is invisible until it breaks, and on Bedrock it breaks immediately.

latest.title: Write Custom Data Directly to CloudFront Access Logs with CloudFront Functions
latest.description:
CloudFront Functions now provides the `cf.logCustomData()` helper method, which writes data such as A/B test assignments, authorization outcomes, and URL rewrite results to CloudFront access logs. This article explains the log fields, configuration steps, code examples, and how to query the data with Amazon Athena.
The examples in this article demonstrate the relevant APIs and log fields. Adjust the configuration for your environment before deployment.

latest.title: Efficient Asset Archiving Connecting AEM with AWS S3 Glacier
latest.description: As DAM repositories grow into terabytes, AEM performance and storage costs suffer. This guide integrates AEM with S3 Glacier using AWS SDK for Java v2: an OSGi service, a workflow that streams originals to Glacier IR, and a restore path back into the DAM.

latest.title: Intelligent Incident Prediction in Banking Cloud Operations: A Machine Learning Framework for Proactive SRE Response
latest.description:
About This Research

This post summarizes findings from my peer-reviewed paper published at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Computing, Business and Internet of Things (ICCBI 2026), held at Manipal Academy of Higher Education, Dubai. The paper (ICCBI-874) introduces a machine learning framework for proactive incident prediction in banking cloud operations, directly aligned with SRE best practices on AWS.

latest.title: The Agentic Stack Is Collapsing Build the Tools, Not the Framework
latest.description: gent frameworks, skill libraries, and orchestration layers keep getting replaced every few months. What's emerging is simpler: a capable model, a clean tool suite, and lightweight steering. This article covers how I used Kiro + Amazon Bedrock to build automated tooling without heavy orchestration, why companies should be structuring their workloads to be AI-ready now, and how to adopt incrementally using familiar safe-deployment patterns like A/B testing and blue/green rollouts.
